metadata.routeStatusPolicy: Environment Ministry of Japan published this GPX as GPS-usable Tokai Nature Trail route information and says prefectures cooperated in improving it. Its notice warns residual positional error may remain and says closed sections are not provided with detours. This catalog simplifies the source geometry for discovery display. All records remain 待核验; the simplified lines do not establish current opening, legal access, or safe navigation. Check the Ministry source page and local-government notices before travel.
